definitions.explanation: Something that does not move or cannot be moved. Used both literally (not moving physically) and figuratively (firm, unwavering, established beyond doubt).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エース→エース：28537_eesu⟧だ。
{不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ち→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: He continued standing in an unmoving posture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたり{不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a brand that has boasted unwavering popularity for many years.

notes:
Frequently used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧ (unshakeable position), {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ (unwavering popularity). In sports, {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レギュラー→レギュラー：11396_regyuraa⟧ means an undisputed regular player.

Also appears in the Buddhist term {不動明王|ふどうみょうおう} (Acala), one of the Wisdom Kings who is depicted with an immovable, fierce expression.

The compound ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧ (real estate, lit. "immovable property") is derived from this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧ — an unshakeable position
- {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧ — unwavering popularity
- {不動|ふどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レギュラー→レギュラー：11396_regyuraa⟧ — an undisputed regular (sports)
- {不動明王|ふどうみょうおう} — Acala (Buddhist deity)
